title: Execute four-codebook quaternary-selector palette-Scale18 W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after deterministic candidate A/B identity, exact palette-Scale18 codec closure, legal four-bank and quaternary-selector geometry, 169/169 V10-ledger non-regression, strict aggregate V10 SSE improvement, 8/8 construction-blind non-evaluator exactness, 312 legal Dynamic Scale32 events, and complete hash verification produce PREATTEMPT_READY.json.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V11 runner and scalable backend directly from the pinned BF16 source. Use four signed-Q4.4 codebook banks per 128-input block, a two-bit selector per output row and block, and one four-entry exponent palette plus exact 18-bit row records per tensor. Do not modify RTL, the live chat path, sealed evidence, or Manager-owned stage state.

required_constructor.source_only_initialization: Do not reconstruct or replay V10. Construct all 169 tensors directly from authenticated BF16 weights; use only the sealed V10 per-tensor SSE values as a numeric non-regression ledger.
required_constructor.palette_scale18: four strictly increasing legal signed exponents per tensor, followed by row-ordered 16-bit normalized significands plus two-bit palette indices; exact decode, 16-byte alignment, and zero padding are mandatory
required_constructor.four_codebooks: four strictly increasing sixteen-entry signed-Q4.4 int8 banks per contiguous 128 input lanes
required_constructor.quaternary_selector: two bits per output row and input block for every transformer Linear and lm_head
required_constructor.selector_packing: output-row-major then input-block-major, least-significant-bit first, each tensor aligned to 16 bytes, all padding bits zero
required_constructor.objective: exact unweighted BF16 source-space SSE for all 169 Linear tensors
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A/B payload, exponent-palette, row-record, four-codebook, selector, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests match byte-for-byte
required_constructor.model_gate: all 169 tensors are non-regressing against the sealed V10 per-tensor SSE ledger and aggregate literal unweighted BF16 SSE is strictly below 2153.4047236346078

required_before_marker: hash-bound V11 runner, scalable backend, exact palette-Scale18 codec, and constructor self-test result
candidate A and B payload, exponent-palette, row-record, four-codebook, selector, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests
codec tests for palette ordering/range, legal extrema, row-bit ordering, cross-byte records, exact round trip, truncation, extension, nonzero padding, stream alignment, and hash rejection

constructor tests for energy-bucket initialization, four-bank ordering, quaternary selector ordering, codepoint legality, nibble packing, Scale32 candidates, empty banks, all-zero rows, palette coordinate updates, metadata sequencing, and deterministic ties
model-only report proving 169/169 V10-ledger non-regression and strict aggregate V10 SSE improvement
the unchanged eight non-evaluator inputs at 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes

fresh-candidate Dynamic Scale32 report with all 312 layer/event names, legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, no reserved -128 payload, and 832 or fewer activation-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token
predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix hash, runner, tool version, format, byte count, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer returns done after reproducing either a sealed marker-free PREATTEMPT_NO_GO with zero attempts consumed or a sealed single authorized attempt, and verifies exact palette-Scale18 and byte accounting, deterministic four-bank construction, the V10-ledger model gate, 8/8 preflight quality, 312-event Dynamic Scale32 legality, and all bound hashes.
prohibited_work: modify, resume, replay, reconstruct, reinterpret, or officially execute V10 or any consumed or terminal predecessor
create the V11 execution marker during planning, runner development, construction, or preflight
use official nine-prompt inputs, outputs, token arrays, response gates, hidden harness sources, or golden outputs for construction or preflight
change palette size, row-record width, bank count, selector width, or byte accounting after observing any non-evaluator or official prompt result
widen weight payloads, add sparse exceptions or hidden metadata, or exceed 4.036 stored bits per weight
hide palette, selector, padding, alignment, authentication, or duplicate records outside the frozen byte accounting
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
begin U280 integration, emulation, bitstream, or board work
